notes: Static local metadata for shipped provider/model defaults. The widget must not scrape vendor pricing pages at runtime. Entries were re-reviewed on 2026-06-30; manual-review flags remain visible when exact pricing or lifecycle state cannot be represented safely.

providers.label: Anthropic
providers.reviewReason: Reviewed official Anthropic pricing on 2026-06-30; kept manual review because current and legacy Claude model IDs coexist and data-residency/fast-mode modifiers are not represented in the local flat token table.

providers.label: Google Gemini
providers.reviewReason: Reviewed Google AI pricing on 2026-06-30; kept manual review because Gemini and Veo pricing varies by model, tier, media unit, and API surface.

providers.label: Mistral AI
